_comment: Checkable assertions the prose in this brain depends on. A failing claim is a document announcing its own rot. Add a claim whenever a law file states a fact about the disk. Paths expand %USERPROFILE%, ${ROOT}, ${BRAIN}, ${KIT}; a relative path is brain-relative. Types and fields: SPEC 5.2, or the kit's tools/MANUAL.md. A claim the Doctor cannot evaluate is COULD-NOT-LOOK (exit 2), never a pass.

_example.why: The entry file is what every session reads first. If it is gone, every session starts without the prohibitions.

claims.why: The pointer is the one file outside root, brain and plugin. Without it every hook runs brain-less and the Doctor cannot find this brain. Written by adopt.mjs; checked here so a deleted or moved pointer is a RED run, not a silent downgrade.

PRIN-03, VCS-15: this brain's LAW.md is generated from the kit's law.json, this overlay and state/law-installed.json, which adopt writes. The route and subagent hooks hand sessions their law rows from this file. After a plugin update that changes the law, or a hand edit, it differs from a fresh build and this claim is RED until you rebuild it (the command is in the kit's tools/MANUAL.md). A missing state/law-installed.json is COULD-NOT-LOOK: run /design-first:adopt again, and attach mode writes it.

PRIN-04: the HONOUR count in this brain's generated LAW.md may only fall. The first run records the baseline in state/ratchets.json. With no record (first run, deleted state/, after remove) any count passes and becomes the baseline. A rise turns the run RED: give the new rule a mechanism, give it the grade it really has (a standing ruling is OWNER), or sign the raise by adding accepted: { value, since, reason } to this claim; a signed raise works once.

VCS-06: a backup is not a backup until it is proven by a logged restore drill. Clone your brain's remote into a fresh folder, compare HEAD and the file count with the working copy, append one dated line to this log. No log, or a last line older than maxDays, is a RED run. graceFromInstall: the first drill is due maxDays after adopt, read from the write time of state/installed.json.

VCS-12: every folder listed under tombstonedPaths in doctor.config.json holds a TOMBSTONE.md with status:, consumers: and remove: lines. A retired folder with no tombstone is a folder someone will delete while something still reads it. An empty list passes and says so.

DES-01: every repository carries its decisions manifest and its architecture map. Repositories born before `since` (set it to your adopt date) are reported, not failed; a new one must comply. Add `where` or `exclude` for folders that are not projects.
OBS-08: every runnable tool ships a manual with a symptom, meaning and fix table. Selected by the files a runnable project carries; born before `since` is reported, not failed.
